definitions.full: H8216. shephel שֵׁ֫פֶל noun [masculine] low estate, condition ; — absolute ׳שׁ Eccl 10:6 (opposed to מְרוֺמִים ); suffix שִׁפְלֵנוּ Psalm 136:33.
